import pandas as pd

def clean(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    # Fix label variants
    df["species"] = df["species"].str.strip().replace({"Adeile": "Adelie"})
    df["island"] = df["island"].str.strip()
    df["sex"] = df["sex"].str.strip().str.lower()
    
    # Convert text numbers to float
    df["flipper_length_mm"] = pd.to_numeric(df["flipper_length_mm"], errors='coerce')
    df["body_mass_g"] = pd.to_numeric(df["body_mass_g"], errors='coerce')
    
    # Remove invalid body_mass_g (out of range)
    df = df[(df["body_mass_g"] >= 2500) & (df["body_mass_g"] <= 6500)]
    
    return df

def answer(df: pd.DataFrame) -> dict:
    # Group by species and calculate average body mass
    result = df.groupby("species")["body_mass_g"].mean().round(2).to_dict()
    
    # Add overall average
    result["all"] = df["body_mass_g"].mean().round(2)
    
    return result
